claims.statement: Agent health checks apply only to running, healthy or unhealthy assigned task states.
limitations: Observation is not automatic Docker termination, rollout choice or total availability.

claims.statement: Agent builds loopback target from assigned TCP published ports; unassigned port yields no probe.
limitations: Direct DefaultChecker callers can supply other initial targets; no universal address allowlist claimed.

claims.statement: Agent tracks consecutive successes/failures and returns before updating counters when checker returns error.
limitations: Counters are memory-local; thresholds are not persisted historical totals.

claims.statement: Actual owned-loopback health suite passed HTTP/TCP and redirect-boundary tests including cross-origin rejection.
limitations: Original restricted-sandbox bind failure preserved; passing retry used only temporary local listeners, not external SSRF probes.
